items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: did I mention the thing that I did with Benny and Bob Freeman?

ctx.x: Oh, naturally, because we could do it over, you know. And we exchanged ideas, and it was just the-- you know, it wasn't a frantic thing where we just played. We played until we, you know, got tired and we'd stop, we'd talk, have coffee, or something, just play. It was just good fellowship, you know, and that was quite enjoyable. Yeah, I enjoyed it.

I? Yeah, but that was the -- personnel of that band -- I can't remember all of it but it was just a beautiful band.
